# Generated by CRN-craft. Stochastic-count semantics; reference SSA only.

import gillespy2 as gp

def build_model():
    if gp.__version__ != "1.8.3":
        raise RuntimeError('Requires GillesPy2 1.8.3')
    model = gp.Model(name="enzyme_mechanism", population=True, volume=1.0)
    species = [
        gp.Species(name='S0', initial_value=50, mode='discrete'),
        gp.Species(name='S1', initial_value=10, mode='discrete'),
        gp.Species(name='S2', initial_value=0, mode='discrete'),
        gp.Species(name='S3', initial_value=0, mode='discrete'),
    ]
    model.add_species(species)
    rate = gp.Parameter(name='K0', expression=0.01)
    model.add_parameter(rate)
    model.add_reaction(gp.Reaction(name='R0', reactants={species[1]: 1, species[0]: 1}, products={species[2]: 1}, rate=rate))
    rate = gp.Parameter(name='K1', expression=0.1)
    model.add_parameter(rate)
    model.add_reaction(gp.Reaction(name='R1', reactants={species[2]: 1}, products={species[1]: 1, species[0]: 1}, rate=rate))
    rate = gp.Parameter(name='K2', expression=0.5)
    model.add_parameter(rate)
    model.add_reaction(gp.Reaction(name='R2', reactants={species[2]: 1}, products={species[1]: 1, species[3]: 1}, rate=rate))
    return model
